WITH sex_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.SEX), ''), '(blank/missing)') AS sex_group,
         COUNT(*) AS examined_count
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
  GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.SEX), ''), '(blank/missing)')
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(examined_count) AS overall_total,
         AVG(examined_count) AS per_sex_average
  FROM sex_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT sc.examined_count,
         1.0 * sc.examined_count / t.overall_total AS share,
         sc.examined_count - t.per_sex_average AS above_average_by
  FROM sex_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
  WHERE sc.examined_count > t.per_sex_average
)
SELECT sex_group,
       examined_count,
       1.0 * examined_count / (SELECT overall_total FROM totals) AS share_of_overall
FROM sex_counts
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Combined above-average sexes' AS sex_group,
       SUM(examined_count) AS examined_count,
       AVG(share) AS share_of_overall
FROM above_average
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Average amount above per-sex average' AS sex_group,
       AVG(above_average_by) AS examined_count,
       AVG(share) AS share_of_overall
FROM above_average;
